```{ojs}
afsEmploymentChart = {
  const t = nbText.GenderedAfriAG.afsEmployment;
  const isDiff = afsSex === "diff";
  let long;
  if (isDiff) {
    // Women minus men, per segment; the stacked (diverging) bars sum to the
    // total AFS-share gap.
    const bySex = d3.group(afsEmployment, (d) => d.iso3n, (d) => d.sex);
    long = [...bySex.values()].flatMap((sexes) => {
      const f = sexes.get("F")?.[0];
      const m = sexes.get("M")?.[0];
      if (!f || !m) return [];
      return [
        { country: countryNameN(f.iso3n, f.area), segment: t.segments.onFarm, pct: +(f.pctAgr - m.pctAgr).toFixed(1) },
        { country: countryNameN(f.iso3n, f.area), segment: t.segments.offFarm, pct: +(f.pctOffFarm - m.pctOffFarm).toFixed(1) },
      ];
    });
  } else {
    const rows = afsEmployment.filter((d) => d.sex === afsSex);
    long = rows.flatMap((d) => [
      { country: countryNameN(d.iso3n, d.area), segment: t.segments.onFarm, pct: d.pctAgr, empl: d.emplAgrK },
      { country: countryNameN(d.iso3n, d.area), segment: t.segments.offFarm, pct: d.pctOffFarm, empl: d.emplOffFarmK },
    ]);
  }
  return Plot.plot({
    style: chartStyle,
    width: Math.min(width, 820),
    height: 60 + (long.length / 2) * 26,
    marginLeft: 130,
    marginTop: isDiff ? 24 : 20,
    x: { label: isDiff ? t.axisDiff : t.axis, grid: true },
    y: { label: null, tickFormat: (d) => wrapTickLabel(d, 18) },
    color: {
      legend: true,
      domain: [t.segments.onFarm, t.segments.offFarm],
      range: ["#216729", "#64acbe"],
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.barX(long, {
        x: "pct",
        y: "country",
        fill: "segment",
        stroke: "white",
        strokeWidth: 0.75,
        sort: { y: "-x", reduce: "sum" },
        channels: isDiff ? {} : { [t.tooltip.employed]: "empl" },
        tip: true,
      }),
      Plot.ruleX([0]),
      ...(isDiff
        ? [
            Plot.text([t.diffHints.men], {
              frameAnchor: "top-left",
              dy: -18,
              fontWeight: "bold",
              fill: "currentColor",
            }),
            Plot.text([t.diffHints.women], {
              frameAnchor: "top-right",
              dy: -18,
              fontWeight: "bold",
              fill: "currentColor",
            }),
          ]
        : []),
    ],
    caption: t.caption,
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
// Add row, column, and grand means around a heatmap and label them in bold.
heatmapMeanMarks = (rows, { x, y, v, avg, textThreshold = 50 }) => {
  const cells = rows.map((d) => ({ x: x(d), y: y(d), v: v(d) }));
  const mean = (subset) => (subset.length ? Math.round(d3.mean(subset, (c) => c.v) * 10) / 10 : null);
  const columns = [...new Set(cells.map((c) => c.x))];
  const countries = [...new Set(cells.map((c) => c.y))];
  const means = [
    ...columns.map((xv) => ({ x: xv, y: avg, v: mean(cells.filter((c) => c.x === xv)) })),
    ...countries.map((yv) => ({ x: avg, y: yv, v: mean(cells.filter((c) => c.y === yv)) })),
    { x: avg, y: avg, v: mean(cells) },
  ].filter((c) => c.v != null);
  return [
    Plot.cell([...cells, ...means], { x: "x", y: "y", fill: "v", inset: 1, tip: true }),
    Plot.text(means, {
      x: "x", y: "y", text: (c) => c.v, fontWeight: "bold",
      fill: (c) => (c.v >= textThreshold ? "white" : "#222"),
    }),
  ];
}

womenCropsChart = {
  const t = nbText.GenderedAfriAG.FemaleParticipationCrops;
  const avg = t.average;
  const country = (d) => nbText.General.adminNames[d.country] ?? d.country;
  const rows = cropGenderData.filter((d) => d.pctFemale != null);
  const order = d3.groupSort(rows, (g) => -d3.mean(g, (d) => d.pctFemale), country);
  return Plot.plot({
    style: chartStyle,
    width: Math.min(width, 760),
    height: 70 + (order.length + 1) * 44,
    marginLeft: 95,
    marginBottom: 55,
    x: { label: null, domain: [...Object.values(t.plot.crops), avg], tickFormat: (d) => wrapTickLabel(d, 14) },
    y: { label: null, domain: [...order, avg] },
    color: { type: "linear", range: ["#F7D732", "#216729"], legend: true, label: t.legend },
    marks: heatmapMeanMarks(rows, {
      x: (d) => t.plot.crops[d.cropGroup] ?? d.cropGroup,
      y: country, v: (d) => d.pctFemale, avg, textThreshold: 45,
    }),
    caption: t.caption,
  });
}
```

```{ojs}
heatHazardText = nbText.GenderHotspots.wbgtMap.selectors.hazard

// Built once: nothing in here depends on the hazard, so changing one field cannot
// rebuild the others and all three keep their values.
viewof heatSettings = {
  const scenario = Inputs.select(["ssp245", "ssp585"], {
    label: nbText.GenderHotspots.wbgtMap.selectors.scenario.title,
    format: (k) => nbText.GenderHotspots.wbgtMap.selectors.scenario.options[k],
    width: 190,
  });
  // Tagged so the cell below can disable it in place; rebuilding this form to pass
  // `disabled` would reset the hazard and period along with it.
  scenario.dataset.control = "scenario";

  return Inputs.form(
    {
      hazard: Inputs.radio(Object.keys(heatHazardText.options), {
        value: "human",
        label: heatHazardText.title,
        format: (k) => heatHazardText.options[k],
      }),
      timeframe: Inputs.select(["historic", "2030", "2050"], {
        label: nbText.GenderHotspots.wbgtMap.selectors.timeframe.title,
        format: (k) => nbText.GenderHotspots.wbgtMap.selectors.timeframe.options[k],
        width: 190,
      }),
      scenario,
    },
    { template: inputTemplate({ gap: "1.5em" }) },
  );
}

heatHazard = heatSettings.hazard
heatTimeframe = heatSettings.timeframe
heatScenario = heatSettings.scenario

// Livestock has none: THI is an index, not a count above a cutoff. An empty
// Inputs.form is still a real element with an empty value, so the control can
// disappear and come back — Inputs.input returns no element and cannot.
heatThresholds = ({ human: [28, 30], crop: [35, 40] })[heatHazard]

viewof heatThresholdControl = Inputs.form(
  {
    ...(heatThresholds && {
      threshold: Inputs.radio(heatThresholds, {
        value: heatThresholds[0],
        label: nbText.GenderHotspots.wbgtMap.selectors.threshold.title,
        format: (v) => `${v}°C${heatHazard === "human" ? " WBGT" : ""}`,
      }),
    }),
  },
  { template: inputTemplate({ gap: "1.5em" }) },
)

heatThreshold = heatThresholdControl.threshold

// A scenario means nothing for the historic period, so grey it out. Disabled rather
// than hidden: removing it would reflow the row under the cursor.
{
  const scenario = viewof heatSettings.querySelector('[data-control="scenario"]');
  scenario.querySelector("select").disabled = heatTimeframe === "historic";
  scenario.style.opacity = heatTimeframe === "historic" ? 0.45 : 1;
}
```

```{ojs}
adaptiveCapacityChart = {
  const t = nbText.GenderInvestments.adaptiveCapacity;
  const rows = adaptiveCapacity.filter((d) => d.iso3n === capCountry);
  const label = (d) => t.indicators[d.indicator];
  const order = Object.values(t.indicators);
  const pairs = d3.groups(rows, label).map(([indicator, g]) => ({
    indicator,
    lo: d3.min(g, (d) => d.value),
    hi: d3.max(g, (d) => d.value),
  }));
  const plot = Plot.plot({
    style: chartStyle,
    width: Math.min(width, 760),
    height: 500,
    marginBottom: 70,
    x: { domain: order, label: null, tickFormat: (d) => wrapTickLabel(d, 16) },
    y: { domain: [0, 100], grid: true, label: t.axisY },
    color: { legend: true, domain: [t.sexes.F, t.sexes.M], range: ["#d6604d", "#4393c3"] },
    marks: [
      Plot.ruleX(pairs, { x: "indicator", y1: "lo", y2: "hi", stroke: "#bbb", strokeWidth: 2 }),
      Plot.dot(rows, {
        x: label,
        y: "value",
        fill: (d) => t.sexes[d.sex],
        r: 7,
        stroke: "white",
        strokeWidth: 1,
        tip: true,
        channels: { year: "year" },
      }),
    ],
    caption: t.caption,
  });
  return plot;
}
```

```{ojs}
adaptiveCapacityMap = {
  const t = nbText.GenderInvestments.adaptiveCapacity;
  const { indicator, view } = capMapControls;
  const rows = adaptiveCapacity.filter((d) => d.indicator === indicator);
  const byIso = d3.rollup(
    rows,
    (g) => {
      const f = g.find((d) => d.sex === "F");
      const m = g.find((d) => d.sex === "M");
      return {
        F: f?.value ?? null,
        M: m?.value ?? null,
        gap: f && m ? +(f.value - m.value).toFixed(1) : null,
        year: f?.year ?? m?.year,
      };
    },
    (d) => d.iso3n,
  );
  const data = [...byIso].map(([iso3n, v]) => ({ iso3n, ...v }));
  const features = mergeDataToBoundaries({
    boundaries: africaA0,
    data,
    boundaryKey: "iso3n",
    dataKey: "iso3n",
  });
  const isGap = view === "gap";
  const maxGap = d3.max(data, (d) => Math.abs(d.gap ?? 0)) || 10;
  const map = makeChoropleth({
    features: features.features,
    width: Math.min(width, 820),
    height: 480,
    fill: (d) => d.properties.data?.[view] ?? undefined,
    color: isGap
      ? { type: "linear", scheme: "RdBu", domain: [-maxGap, maxGap], unknown: "#e0e0e0", label: t.map.legendGap }
      : { type: "linear", scheme: "YlGnBu", domain: [0, 100], unknown: "#e0e0e0", label: `${t.indicators[indicator]} (%)` },
    channels: {
      country: { label: " ", value: (d) => countryNameN(d.properties.iso3n) },
      women: { label: t.sexes.F, value: (d) => d.properties.data?.F },
      men: { label: t.sexes.M, value: (d) => d.properties.data?.M },
    },
    tooltip: { country: true, women: true, men: true },
    adminHighlight: {
      filter: (d) => d.properties.iso3n === capCountry,
      stroke: "#111",
      strokeWidth: 2,
    },
  });
  return map;
}
```

{{< prose bridge-gap >}}

```{ojs}
bridgeGapMatrix = {
  const t = nbText.BridgeGap;
  const rows = genderSolutions.flatMap((d) =>
    d.Risk.split(", ").map((risk) => ({ ...d, risk })),
  );
  const riskLabel = (d) => t.table.tooltip[d.risk.toLowerCase()] ?? d.risk;
  const catLabel = (d) => t.selector.options[d["Adaptation Options"]] ?? d["Adaptation Options"];
  const outcomeLabel = (o) => t.table.values[o.toLowerCase()] ?? o;
  const cells = d3.flatGroup(rows, catLabel, riskLabel).map(([cat, risk, g]) => {
    const counts = d3.rollup(g, (v) => v.length, (d) => d["Gender Outcome Score"]);
    const top = [...counts.entries()].sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0][0];
    return {
      cat,
      risk,
      n: g.length,
      outcome: outcomeLabel(top),
      outcomes: [...counts.entries()].map(([o, n]) => `${outcomeLabel(o)}: ${n}`).join(", "),
      geographies: [...new Set(g.map((d) => d.Geography))].join(", "),
    };
  });
  const outcomeKeys = ["enabling", "reinforcing", "constraining", "counteracting"];
  const outcomeColors = {
    enabling: "#216729",
    reinforcing: "#74c476",
    constraining: "#ef8a62",
    counteracting: "#b2182b",
  };
  const lightFills = [t.table.values.reinforcing, t.table.values.constraining];
  const riskOrder = d3.groupSort(cells, (g) => -d3.sum(g, (d) => d.n), (d) => d.risk);
  return Plot.plot({
    style: chartStyle,
    width: Math.min(width, 820),
    height: 80 + riskOrder.length * 42,
    marginLeft: 150,
    marginBottom: 55,
    x: { label: null, domain: Object.values(t.selector.options), tickFormat: (d) => wrapTickLabel(d, 16) },
    y: { label: null, domain: riskOrder },
    color: {
      legend: true,
      label: t.matrix.legend,
      domain: outcomeKeys.map((k) => t.table.values[k]),
      range: outcomeKeys.map((k) => outcomeColors[k]),
    },
    marks: [
      Plot.cell(cells, {
        x: "cat",
        y: "risk",
        fill: "outcome",
        inset: 1,
        tip: true,
        channels: {
          [t.table.headings["Gender Outcome Score"]]: "outcomes",
          [t.table.headings.Geography]: "geographies",
        },
      }),
      Plot.text(cells, {
        x: "cat",
        y: "risk",
        text: "n",
        fill: (d) => (lightFills.includes(d.outcome) ? "#222" : "white"),
      }),
    ],
    caption: t.matrix.caption,
  });
}
```

## Data import and cleaning

```{ojs}
// IFPRI global ranking filtered to 41 Atlas countries; retain composite indices.
hotspotData = FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/ifpriGenderHotspots_africa.json").json()

africaA0 = {
  const topo = await FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_gaul24_a0_africa_simple-vlowres.topojson").json();
  return topojson.feature(topo, topo.objects.atlas_gaul24_a0_africa);
}

hotspotFeatures = mergeDataToBoundaries({
  boundaries: africaA0,
  data: hotspotData,
  boundaryKey: (f) => f.properties.iso3,
  dataKey: "iso3",
})

// Key localized country names by UN M49, falling back to boundary names.
countryNamesByN = {
  const atlas = await FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_countries.json").json();
  const byIso3 = new Map(atlas.map((r) => [r.iso3c, r.translation]));
  return new Map(
    africaA0.features.map((f) => {
      const tr = byIso3.get(f.properties.iso3) ?? {};
      return [f.properties.iso3n, {
        en: tr.en ?? f.properties.un_a0_en,
        fr: tr.fr ?? f.properties.un_a0_fr,
      }];
    }),
  );
}

countryNameN = (iso3n, fallback = "") =>
  countryNamesByN.get(iso3n)?.[language.key] ?? countryNamesByN.get(iso3n)?.en ?? fallback

// Keys double as the field names in hotspotData.
hotspotIndicators = nbText.GlobalHotspots.indicators
```

```{ojs}
// Use pinned hyparquet for these small Snappy files; no DuckDB worker is needed.
hypq = import("https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/hyparquet@1.26.2/+esm")


// WBGT heat stress + women-in-agriculture tables extracted to GAUL24 admin0/1
// by notebookv2/scripts/extract_gender_layers.R (join key: gaul1_code).
wbgtData = hypq.parquetQuery({
  file: await FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/wbgt_gaul24_africa.parquet").arrayBuffer(),
})

// Crop (NTx) and livestock (THI), same shape as wbgtData. Historic comes from the
// CIS baseline and the futures from the ensemble export; both are aggregated over
// Jägermeyr growing seasons, which is what makes the two halves comparable.
heatHazardData = hypq.parquetQuery({
  file: await FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/heatHazards_gaul24_africa.parquet").arrayBuffer(),
})

womenAgriData = hypq.parquetQuery({
  file: await FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/women-agri_gaul24_africa.parquet").arrayBuffer(),
})

africaA1 = {
  const topo = await FileAttachment("/data/shared/atlas_gaul24_a1_africa_simple-vlowres.topojson").json();
  return topojson.feature(topo, topo.objects.atlas_gaul24_a1_africa);
}

// Latest FAOSTAT/ILO agrifood employment by sex and country.
afsEmployment = hypq.parquetQuery({
  file: await FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/afsEmployment_faostat.parquet").arrayBuffer(),
})

// Latest sex-disaggregated FAOSTAT capacity indicators; higher percentages are better.
adaptiveCapacity = hypq.parquetQuery({
  file: await FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/adaptiveCapacity_faostat.parquet").arrayBuffer(),
})

capCountryNames = new Map(
  adaptiveCapacity.map((d) => [d.iso3n, countryNameN(d.iso3n, d.area)]),
)

// Gender outcomes of adaptation solutions: 24 coded studies on African
// agriculture from Roy, Prakash, Some et al. (2022).
genderSolutions = FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/gender_solutions.json").json()

iso3ToN = new Map(
  africaA0.features.map((f) => [f.properties.iso3, f.properties.iso3n]),
)

// Women's control over livestock products (milk, eggs, meat) per country.
// RHoMIS surveys, extracted by notebookv2/scripts/extract_rhomis_livestockControl.sql.
livestockControl = FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/livestockControl_rhomis.json").json()

// Women's share of crop-production labor, 6 countries (Palacios-Lopez et al.
// 2017; wide source rows reshaped to long).
cropGenderData = {
  const wide = await FileAttachment("/data/genderExposure/crop_gender_data.json").json();
  return wide.flatMap(({ country, ...groups }) =>
    Object.entries(groups).map(([cropGroup, pctFemale]) => ({ country, cropGroup, pctFemale })),
  );
}
```

```{ojs}
// Bivariate map data: heat days for the current selection joined to the
// women-in-agriculture percentages at admin1.
womenByGaul1 = new Map(
  womenAgriData.filter((d) => d.admin1_name != null).map((d) => [d.gaul1_code, d]),
)

biVarRows = {
  const scen = heatTimeframe === "historic" ? "historic" : heatScenario;
  return heatRows
    .filter((d) =>
      d.admin1_name != null &&
      d.timeframe === heatTimeframe &&
      d.scenario === scen &&
      (heatThresholds == null || d.threshold === heatThreshold)
    )
    .map((d) => {
      const w = womenByGaul1.get(d.gaul1_code);
      return { ...d, pct_women_agri: w?.pct_women_agri ?? null, women_agri_count: w?.women_agri_count ?? null };
    });
}

biVarFeatures = mergeDataToBoundaries({
  boundaries: africaA1,
  data: biVarRows,
  boundaryKey: "gaul1_code",
  dataKey: "gaul1_code",
})

heatRows = heatHazard === "human"
  ? wbgtData
  : heatHazardData.filter((d) => d.hazard === heatHazard)

// Each hazard is a different quantity: WBGT counts days per YEAR above a cutoff,
// NTx days per MONTH of the growing season, THI is an index. Livestock cuts follow
// the standard THI scale (no/mild <79, moderate 79-89, severe >=90) — the bivariate
// palette is 3x3, so no-stress and mild share a class, which is also where the
// fewest units sit. Crop 40°C needs its own breaks because two thirds of units sat
// at or below 0.3 days historically. Women 20/50%.
heatClass = d3.scaleThreshold(
  heatHazard === "human" ? [30, 90]
  : heatHazard === "livestock" ? [79, 90]
  : heatThreshold === 40 ? [0.3, 2]
  : [1, 6],
  d3.range(3),
)

womenClass = d3.scaleThreshold([20, 50], d3.range(3))

// 3x3 bivariate ramp from the previous notebook version (women axis = rows,
// heat axis = columns; index 0 = both low, 8 = both high).
biVarPalette = ["#e8e8e8", "#e4acac", "#c85a5a", "#b0d5df", "#ad9ea5", "#985356", "#64acbe", "#627f8c", "#574249"]

biVarColor = (row) => {
  if (!row || !Number.isFinite(row.value) || !Number.isFinite(row.pct_women_agri)) {
    return "#e0e0e0";
  }
  return biVarPalette[womenClass(row.pct_women_agri) * 3 + heatClass(row.value)];
}

// makeBivariateLegend expects colors keyed "<x> × <y>" (x = women, y = heat).
biVarColors = {
  const cls = ["Low", "Moderate", "High"];
  const out = {};
  for (let w = 0; w < 3; w++) {
    for (let h = 0; h < 3; h++) {
      out[`${cls[w]} × ${cls[h]}`] = biVarPalette[w * 3 + h];
    }
  }
  return out;
}
```
